name: Academic cord
size_basis: Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1. Length 4.1 in = the Class B shirt shoulder seam (~4.1 in on garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male) and 0.3 in longer than the 3.8 in epaulet strap on the Class A coat (seam 5.04 in), so the cord stays inside the coat silhouette; 0.5 in across, the width the engine draws a shoulder cord at (it was 0.40 before the guidance's cord). The braid is the cord of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures, measured on the Class A figure (link pitch 28.0 px on a braid 38.65 px across: 0.36 in a link at 0.5 in across; the Class B figure agrees within 4 percent): see CordBraid.LOOK in base-art/cord-braid.js. Colours are the palette of assets/cords/cords.json.
provenance: in-house vector: the braid is the cord of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures, its link, lobe, strip, outline and cap proportions measured on the figure (base-art/cord-braid.js); colours from the palette of assets/cords/cords.json (the regulation cords keep the colours they had)

dimensions.form: braided shoulder cord (box braid, a chain of links of two barrelled lobes and a two-cell centre strip)
dimensions.orientation: drawn vertically: top = neck end of the shoulder seam, bottom = sleeve (arm) end; the bow (0.25 in) falls toward the body, i.e. down the garment front when the cord lies on the shoulder
dimensions.attach: align cord_start (neck end) with the neck end of the wearer's LEFT shoulder seam and run it down the seam toward the shoulder point; rotate to the seam angle

garment_fit.note: strap axis = line from the neck end to the arm end of the garment's left epaulet strap / shoulder strip (garment user units, 0.01 in; wearer's left shoulder is on the viewer's right). Place: centre the cord on the axis with shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end at the neck end, rotate so the neck->arm anchors follow the axis, shift the chord 0.125 in toward the neck side so the 0.25 in bow is centred on the strap; draw order garment, layers, cord, then the epaulet sleeve/strip over it

class_b_shirt.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

class_b_blouse_female.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

mounts.uniform: Class A (service dress) and Class B (blue service), cadets only
mounts.rule: worn on the left shoulder, aligned along the shoulder seam, underneath the epaulet if present; one cord at a time; who may wear it and where is the wing or region supplement's rule (CAPR 39-1 9.4.1)

regulation: CAPR 39-1 9.4.1 and the wing or region supplement that names it
